groups.addPlaceholder: Find users or groups by name, uid or email…
groups.memberOfNone: Not a member of any group
groups.memberOfHint: Groups that list this entry as member or uniqueMember

charts.collecting: Collecting data… the first points appear after a few seconds; history is kept for one hour while ds-ui runs.

monitor.cacheWarning: Low hit ratio with a full cache: the cache is probably too small for the working set (nsslapd-cachememsize).
monitor.restartConfirm: Restart the directory server? Clients are disconnected for a few seconds.
monitor.restartRequired: Some changes take effect only after a restart: {reasons}

db.title: Databases
db.name: Backend name
db.readOnlyHint: Reject all write operations to this suffix
db.requireIndexHint: Reject searches that cannot use an index
db.rootMissing: The root entry {suffix} does not exist yet.
db.dangerText: Deletes the backend and ALL entries under {suffix}. This cannot be undone.
db.dangerShort: Removes the backend and all its entries for good.
db.parentSuffixHint: Optional: makes a sub-suffix — its entries appear under the parent in the tree but live in their own database.

indexes.added: Index on {attr} added. Reindex to build it.
indexes.updated: Index updated. Reindex to apply it.
indexes.defaultHint: A suffix created later starts with these indexes. Existing suffixes are not changed.

backups.name: Name
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore ALL databases from {name}? Changes made after this backup are lost and the databases are offline while restoring.
backups.noFiles: Backups can be created, but listing, downloading and deleting them needs access to the server's files (sidecar mode).
backups.sensitive: Backups contain the server configuration including TLS private keys (config_files). Keep downloaded archives as secrets.

ldifFiles.noFiles: LDIF files on the server need access to its files (sidecar mode). For small amounts of data use the LDIF import/export of the LDAP browser.

transfer.exportHint: Writes the whole suffix to a file in the server's LDIF directory (an online task).
transfer.replication: Include replication state (to initialise a replica)
transfer.importHint: Replaces ALL entries of this suffix with the content of the file.
transfer.chooseFile: Choose a file from the LDIF directory
transfer.importWarning: All entries of {suffix} will be replaced with the content of {file}.
transfer.decrypt: Write encrypted attributes in clear text (before turning their encryption off)

logs.title: Logs
logs.filterHint: Words that must all occur, e.g. conn=12 or err=32 or BIND
logs.disabled: This log is disabled on the server
logs.truncated: Only the last 64 MB of the file were searched
logs.buffered: The access log is buffered: new lines appear in batches.
logs.sameAs: Written to the same file as the {other} log
logs.noFiles: Logs need access to the server's files (sidecar mode).
logs.clickHint: Click a line to show every line of its connection

http.forbidden: Your role may not do this
http.tooMany: Too many attempts; wait a few minutes

ldap.unwillingToPerform: The server is unwilling to perform the operation

pages._restartHint: Takes effect after the server is restarted.
pages._dangerHint: A wrong value can cut ds-ui off from the server.
pages._dangerConfirm: You are changing: {fields}. A wrong value can make the server unreachable for ds-ui; fixing it then needs shell access to the container.
pages._savedRestart: Saved. {n} setting takes effect after a restart. | Saved. {n} settings take effect after a restart.

mode.label: File permissions
mode.help: Octal mode of new log files, e.g. 600.

buffering.label: Buffered writes
buffering.help: Faster, but the last lines may appear with a delay.

hideUnhashedPw.label: Hide clear-text passwords
hideUnhashedPw.help: Do not write the unhashed userPassword of changes.

maxlogsperdir.label: Files to keep
maxlogsperdir.help: Maximum number of log files, including the active one.

rotationtime.label: Rotate every
rotationtime.help: Together with the unit below; -1 disables rotation by time.

expirationtime.label: Delete files older than
expirationtime.help: Together with the unit below; -1 keeps them.

maxdiskspace.label: Total size limit
maxdiskspace.help: Oldest files are deleted above this; -1 disables.

minfreediskspace.label: Keep free disk space
minfreediskspace.help: Oldest files are deleted when free space falls below this.

passwordMustChange.label: Change after reset
passwordMustChange.help: Users must change a password set by an administrator.

passwordMinAge.label: Minimum age
passwordMinAge.help: Before the password can be changed again.

passwordAdminDN.label: Password administrators
passwordAdminDN.help: Entry or group that may bypass the policy.

passwordCheckSyntax.label: Check syntax
passwordCheckSyntax.help: Enforce the requirements in this group.

passwordMinCategories.label: Character categories
passwordMinCategories.help: Of digits, upper, lower, special and 8-bit.

passwordMinTokenLength.label: Token length
passwordMinTokenLength.help: Parts of the user's attributes this long must not appear.

passwordMaxSequence.label: Max sequence length
passwordMaxSequence.help: Like abcd or 1234; 0 does not check.

passwordDictPath.label: Dictionary path
passwordDictPath.help: Empty uses the system cracklib dictionary.

passwordUserAttributes.label: Check against attributes
passwordUserAttributes.help: Space-separated attributes of the user that must not appear.

passwordUnlock.label: Unlock automatically
passwordUnlock.help: Otherwise an administrator must reset the password.

nsslapd-localhost.label: Host name
nsslapd-localhost.help: Used in referrals and generated URLs.

nsslapd-port.label: LDAP port
nsslapd-port.help: 0 disables plain LDAP. Inside the container ports are mapped by Docker.

nsslapd-readonly.label: Read-only server
nsslapd-readonly.help: Rejects all writes, including to cn=config.

nsslapd-syntaxcheck.label: Syntax checking
nsslapd-syntaxcheck.help: Rejects values that do not match the attribute syntax.

nsslapd-ignore-virtual-attrs.label: Ignore virtual attributes
nsslapd-ignore-virtual-attrs.help: Faster searches; disable if you use CoS or roles in filters.

nsslapd-return-exact-case.label: Return attribute names as in schema

nsslapd-dynamic-plugins.label: Dynamic plug-ins
nsslapd-dynamic-plugins.help: Plug-in changes take effect without a restart.

nsslapd-plugin-binddn-tracking.label: Track plug-in changes
nsslapd-plugin-binddn-tracking.help: Record the plug-in that made a change in internalModifiersName / internalCreatorsName, next to the bound user in modifiersName.

nsslapd-ignore-time-skew.label: Ignore time skew
nsslapd-ignore-time-skew.help: Keep replicating when replica clocks differ too much (otherwise replication stops with a time-skew error).

server-limits.title: Limits and performance
server-limits.description: Defaults for all clients; users can have their own limits.

nsslapd-sizelimit.label: Size limit
nsslapd-sizelimit.help: Entries returned per search; -1 is unlimited.

nsslapd-ioblocktimeout.label: I/O block timeout
nsslapd-ioblocktimeout.help: A connection blocked this long is closed.

nsslapd-pagedsizelimit.label: Paged search size limit
nsslapd-pagedsizelimit.help: Size limit for searches with the paged results control; 0 uses the general size limit, -1 is unlimited.

nsslapd-maxcontrolsperop.label: Controls per operation
nsslapd-maxcontrolsperop.help: Maximum number of request controls in one operation.

nsslapd-outbound-ldap-io-timeout.label: Outbound I/O timeout
nsslapd-outbound-ldap-io-timeout.help: Timeout of I/O on connections the server opens itself (replication, chaining, pass-through).

nsslapd-listen-backlog-size.label: Listen backlog
nsslapd-listen-backlog-size.help: Connections the operating system queues before the server accepts them.

nsslapd-tcp-keepalive-time.label: TCP keep-alive
nsslapd-tcp-keepalive-time.help: Idle time before TCP keep-alive probes are sent on client connections.

nsslapd-tcp-fin-timeout.label: TCP FIN timeout
nsslapd-tcp-fin-timeout.help: How long closing connections may stay in FIN-WAIT-2.

nsslapd-enable-turbo-mode.label: Turbo mode
nsslapd-enable-turbo-mode.help: A worker thread keeps serving a busy connection instead of returning it to the queue.

disk-monitoring.title: Disk monitoring
disk-monitoring.description: Protects the database when the disk fills up: logs are cut down, then the server stops.

nsslapd-disk-monitoring-grace-period.label: Grace period
nsslapd-disk-monitoring-grace-period.help: Time before the server shuts down once below half the threshold.

nsslapd-disk-monitoring-logging-critical.label: Keep logging
nsslapd-disk-monitoring-logging-critical.help: Do not disable access logging when low on space.

db-global.title: Global database settings
db-global.description: Apply to every backend. Per-backend cache sizes are on the Databases page.

nsslapd-lookthroughlimit.label: Look-through limit
nsslapd-lookthroughlimit.help: Candidate entries examined per search; -1 is unlimited.

nsslapd-idlistscanlimit.label: ID list scan limit
nsslapd-idlistscanlimit.help: Above this an index is treated as unindexed (allids).

nsslapd-backend-implement.label: Database implementation
nsslapd-backend-implement.help: Changing it requires exporting and re-importing all data.

db-mdb.title: LMDB
db-mdb.description: Settings of the LMDB database environment shared by all backends.

nsslapd-mdb-max-size.label: Maximum database size
nsslapd-mdb-max-size.help: The memory map size: the database cannot grow beyond it.

nsslapd-mdb-max-readers.label: Maximum readers
nsslapd-mdb-max-readers.help: 0 sizes automatically from the thread count.

nsslapd-mdb-max-dbs.label: Maximum databases
nsslapd-mdb-max-dbs.help: One per index and backend; raise it for many indexes.

nsslapd-db-durable-transaction.label: Durable transactions
nsslapd-db-durable-transaction.help: Sync to disk on every commit: safer, slower.

nsslapd-errorlog-level.label: Level
nsslapd-errorlog-level.help: Debug bits are very verbose; turn them off after troubleshooting.

log-audit.title: Audit log
log-audit.description: Records every change made to the directory.

nsslapd-auditlog-display-attrs.label: Extra attributes
nsslapd-auditlog-display-attrs.help: Attributes of the changed entry to add to each record, e.g. cn; * for all.

log-auditfail.title: Audit failures
log-auditfail.description: Records changes that the server rejected.

log-security.title: Security log
log-security.description: Binds, authorization failures and TCP-level events.

nsslapd-anonlimitsdn.label: Limits for anonymous
nsslapd-anonlimitsdn.help: Entry whose resource limits apply to anonymous clients.

nsslapd-require-secure-binds.label: Require secure binds
nsslapd-require-secure-binds.help: Simple binds only over TLS or LDAPI.

nsslapd-minssf.label: Minimum SSF
nsslapd-minssf.help: Operations on weaker connections are refused; 0 allows plain LDAP.

nsslapd-allowed-sasl-mechanisms.label: Allowed SASL mechanisms
nsslapd-allowed-sasl-mechanisms.help: Comma-separated; empty allows all. EXTERNAL is always allowed.

ldapi.title: LDAPI
ldapi.description: LDAP over a Unix socket. In the sidecar deployment ds-ui itself connects this way as Directory Manager.

nsslapd-ldapiautobind.label: Autobind
nsslapd-ldapiautobind.help: Bind as the local user that opened the socket.

nsslapd-ldapimaprootdn.label: Root maps to
nsslapd-ldapimaprootdn.help: The DN that the system user root (and the server user) binds as.

password-policy.title: Global password policy
password-policy.description: Applies to all users unless a subtree or user policy overrides it.

password-policy-local.title: Subtree or user policy
password-policy-local.description: A local password policy. Attributes that are not set take the server defaults, not the values of the global policy.

plugin-referint.title: Referential Integrity
plugin-referint.description: Updates or removes references (member, owner, …) when the referenced entry is renamed or deleted.

referint-membership-attr.label: Reference attributes
referint-membership-attr.help: Must be indexed for equality in every backend.

referint-update-delay.label: Update delay
referint-update-delay.help: 0 updates synchronously; a delay batches updates in the background.

referint-logfile.label: Work file
referint-logfile.help: Pending changes when a delay is set.

nsslapd-pluginContainerScope.label: References only from
nsslapd-pluginContainerScope.help: Only fix references held by entries in these subtrees.

plugin-memberof.title: MemberOf
plugin-memberof.description: Maintains memberOf in user entries from the member attributes of groups.

memberOfAllBackends.label: Across all backends
memberOfAllBackends.help: Groups and members may be in different suffixes.

memberOfSkipNested.label: Skip nested groups
memberOfSkipNested.help: Faster when groups are not nested.

memberOfAutoAddOC.label: Object class to add
memberOfAutoAddOC.help: Added to members that do not allow memberOf.

plugin-uniqueness.title: Attribute Uniqueness
plugin-uniqueness.description: Rejects changes that would give two entries the same value of an attribute. Each instance has its own attributes and subtrees; add another one for a separate set of rules.

uniqueness-across-all-subtrees.label: Unique across all subtrees
uniqueness-across-all-subtrees.help: Otherwise each subtree is checked on its own.

uniqueness-top-entry-oc.label: Top entry class
uniqueness-top-entry-oc.help: Instead of subtrees: unique below entries of this class.

plugin-rootdn.title: Root DN Access Control
plugin-rootdn.description: Limits when and from where Directory Manager may bind. ds-ui itself works as Directory Manager.

rootdn-days-allowed.label: Days
rootdn-days-allowed.help: e.g. Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri

plugin-retrocl.title: Retro Changelog
plugin-retrocl.description: Records changes in cn=changelog for applications that poll for them.

nsslapd-attribute.label: Extra attributes
nsslapd-attribute.help: attribute[:alias] recorded with each change, e.g. nsUniqueId:targetUniqueId

plugin-account-policy.title: Account Policy
plugin-account-policy.description: Records logins and locks out accounts that have been inactive for too long.

alwaysRecordLogin.label: Record every login
alwaysRecordLogin.help: Otherwise only for accounts with a policy.

sasl-mappings.title: SASL mappings
sasl-mappings.description: How a SASL identity (e.g. a Kerberos principal) is mapped to an entry. Mappings are tried by priority; groups of the regular expression (\1, \2) are substituted into the templates.

root-password.title: Directory Manager password
root-password.description: The password of the root DN. The server stores it hashed with the Directory Manager scheme of the password policy.

plugin-pam.title: PAM Pass-Through
plugin-pam.description: Checks the passwords of bind DNs with PAM on the server host instead of userPassword.

pamService.label: PAM service
pamService.help: Name of the PAM configuration, e.g. ldapserver.

pamIDMapMethod.label: ID mapping
pamIDMapMethod.help: RDN, DN or ENTRY; several separated by spaces.

pamIDAttr.label: ID attribute
pamIDAttr.help: For ENTRY mapping: the attribute holding the PAM user name.

pamFallback.label: Fall back to LDAP
pamFallback.help: If PAM fails, try the entry's own password.

pamMissingSuffix.label: Missing suffix
pamMissingSuffix.help: What to do when a listed suffix does not exist.

linked-attributes.title: Linked attribute pairs
linked-attributes.description: When an entry names another in the link attribute, the server keeps the back-reference in the managed attribute of that entry.

dna-ranges.title: Number ranges
dna-ranges.description: Assigns unique numbers (uidNumber, gidNumber, …) to new entries.

dnaMagicRegen.label: Magic value
dnaMagicRegen.help: A client sends this value to get a number assigned, e.g. -1.

dnaSharedCfgDN.label: Shared configuration
dnaSharedCfgDN.help: Entry where replicas publish their remaining ranges.

automember-definitions.title: Auto membership definitions
automember-definitions.description: New and changed entries matching a definition are added to groups: to the target groups of the first matching rule, or to the default groups.

managed-entries.title: Managed entry definitions
managed-entries.description: For every entry matching a definition, the server keeps a managed entry built from a template, e.g. a private group for each user. Edit the template entry in the LDAP browser.

managedTemplate.label: Template entry
managedTemplate.help: A mepTemplateEntry with mepRDNAttr, mepStaticAttr, mepMappedAttr.

nsslapd-security.label: TLS enabled
nsslapd-security.help: LDAPS on the secure port and StartTLS on the LDAP port.

nsslapd-securelistenhost.label: LDAPS listen address
nsslapd-securelistenhost.help: Interface the LDAPS port listens on; empty: all.

nsslapd-validate-cert.label: Validate the server certificate
nsslapd-validate-cert.help: At startup: "on" refuses an invalid or expired certificate, "warn" only logs it.

nsslapd-ssl-check-hostname.label: Check host names
nsslapd-ssl-check-hostname.help: Verify the host name in certificates of servers this server connects to (replication, chaining).

nsslapd-extract-pemfiles.label: Extract PEM files
nsslapd-extract-pemfiles.help: Write the certificates and key as PEM files at startup for the OpenLDAP client library used by replication.

nsSSLClientAuth.label: Client certificates
nsSSLClientAuth.help: allowed: clients may present one; required: no connection without one.

nsSSL3Ciphers.label: Ciphers
nsSSL3Ciphers.help: e.g. +all,-rsa_rc4_128_md5; empty: the server's secure defaults.

nsSSLSessionTimeout.label: Session cache timeout
nsSSLSessionTimeout.help: How long TLS sessions can be resumed; 0 uses the default.

server-proxy.title: Proxy protocol
server-proxy.description: Load balancers that may pass the original client address with the HAProxy PROXY protocol.

nsslapd-haproxy-trusted-ip.label: Trusted proxy addresses
nsslapd-haproxy-trusted-ip.help: IP addresses (or networks) of HAProxy or other proxies whose PROXY header is accepted. Empty: the header is not accepted.

tls-module.title: Encryption module
tls-module.description: The PKCS#11 token holding the server certificate and key.

nsSSLToken.label: Token
nsSSLToken.help: "internal (software)" is the NSS database of the server.

plugin-usn.title: USN
plugin-usn.description: Update sequence numbers (entryUSN) for clients that synchronise by change counter.

nsslapd-entryusn-global.label: One counter for all backends
nsslapd-entryusn-global.help: Otherwise each backend counts on its own.

nsslapd-entryusn-import-initval.label: entryUSN of imported entries
nsslapd-entryusn-import-initval.help: A number, or "next" for the next value of the counter.

plugins.protected: Required by the server; cannot be disabled here.
plugins.notDynamic: Dynamic plug-ins are off: enabling, disabling and reconfiguring plug-ins takes effect after a server restart.
plugins.disabledHint: The plug-in is disabled: its settings are kept but have no effect.

rootPassword.confirmSimple: ds-ui connects to the server with a password. If it binds as Directory Manager, it switches to the new password now, but after its own restart it reads the old one from its secret file again.
rootPassword.secretText: ds-ui uses the new password until it restarts. Put it into the file named by

sasl.name: Name
sasl.regexHint: Matched against the SASL identity; parenthesised groups become \1, \2, …
sasl.priorityHint: 1 is tried first, 100 last; 0 leaves it unset (100).

vlv.buildHint: A new VLV index is built right after it is created. Indexing works on the live database: on a large suffix, make a backup first.
vlv.deleteConfirm: Delete the VLV index “{name}” and its sort orders?
vlv.sortHint: One sort order per line: attributes separated by spaces, -attr for descending.

schemaView.name: Name
schemaView.pick: Select a definition in the list
schemaView.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” from the schema? This is possible only while nothing uses it.
schemaView.namesHint: The first name is the main one; letters, digits and hyphens.
schemaView.oidHint: A numeric OID under your organisation's arc, or name-oid for local use.
schemaView.kindHint: Auxiliary classes are added to existing entries; structural ones define an entry.

policies.globalHint: applies to everyone without a local policy
policies.subtreeHint: Every entry below gets this policy (through Class of Service).
policies.userHint: Only this entry gets the policy.
policies.created: Policy for {target} created. Unset settings take the server defaults.
policies.localTurnedOn: Local policies were off in the server settings; they are on now.
policies.localOff: Local policies are off in the server settings: the policies below are ignored.
policies.deleteSubtree: Delete the policy of {target}? Entries below go back to the global policy.
policies.deleteUser: Delete the policy of {target}? The user goes back to the subtree or global policy.

account.title: Account
account.roleNote: The lock comes from a role or Class of Service; change it there.

aci.title: Access control (ACI)
aci.deleteConfirm: Delete this ACI? Access it grants or denies changes at once.
aci.inherited: {n} ACI from parent entries | {n} ACIs from parent entries
aci.inheritedNote: ACIs of parent entries apply here unless their targets exclude this entry.
aci.looksOk: No obvious mistakes; the server checks the rest when saving.

problems.name: The rule needs a name: acl "…".
problems.rights: Rights must follow in parentheses: allow (read, search).
problems.bindRule: No bind rule (userdn, groupdn, roledn, userattr, ip, …).

aci.effectiveHint: What a bind DN may do with {dn}, as the server evaluates its ACIs.
aci.subjectPlaceholder: Bind DN, e.g. uid=jdoe,ou=People,…; empty for anonymous

collections.name: Name
collections.nameHint: Becomes the cn of the configuration entry.

params.maxusn_to_delete: Only tombstones up to this USN (empty: all)

memberof-fixup.title: Rebuild memberOf
memberof-fixup.description: Recomputes memberOf of the entries below the base, e.g. after enabling the plug-in on existing data.

automember-rebuild.title: Rebuild memberships
automember-rebuild.description: Applies the definitions to existing entries (they normally act only on new and changed ones).

linkedattrs-fixup.title: Fix up links
linkedattrs-fixup.description: Recreates the managed attributes from the link attributes.

usn-cleanup.title: Clean up tombstones
usn-cleanup.description: Deletes tombstone entries (deleted entries kept for USN-based synchronisation) of the suffix.

schema-reload.title: Reload schema
schema-reload.description: Reads the schema files again after they were edited on disk; definitions in 99user.ldif made through LDAP stay.

kindHints.managed: Members are listed explicitly: their entries name the role in nsRoleDN.
kindHints.filtered: Members are the entries of the subtree that match a filter.
kindHints.nested: Members are the members of the roles it contains.

roles.name: Name
roles.parentHint: The role applies to entries in this subtree.
roles.truncated: Only the first entries are shown.
roles.memberPlaceholder: DN of the entry to add
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role {name}? Entries lose it at once.

kindHints.pointer: All entries of the subtree get the values of one template.
kindHints.classic: Each entry gets the template named by the value of its specifier attribute.
kindHints.indirect: Each entry names its template (any entry) in an attribute.

cos.name: Name
cos.parentHint: The values are added to entries of this subtree.
cos.attributesHint: Attribute, optionally a qualifier: default, override, operational, operational-default, merge-schemes.
cos.specifierHint: Attribute of the entry whose value names the template, e.g. employeeType.
cos.indirectHint: Attribute of the entry holding the template DN, e.g. manager.
cos.templateValueHint: Entries with this value get the template.
cos.priorityHint: When templates compete, 0 wins; empty: lowest.
cos.valuesHint: One value per line; empty removes the attribute.
cos.deleteConfirm: Delete the definition {name}? Its templates stay.

replication.disabledTitle: Replication is off for this suffix
replication.disabledHint: Choose the role of this server. Suppliers accept changes and send them on; hubs and consumers only receive them.

roleHints.supplier: Accepts writes and sends changes to other servers (multi-supplier).
roleHints.hub: Read-only; receives changes and passes them on to consumers.
roleHints.consumer: Read-only; receives changes. Writes are referred to a supplier.

replication.replicaIdHint: Unique among the suppliers of the topology, 1–65534.
replication.bindDNHint: The account other suppliers use to send changes here.
replication.purgeDelayHint: Seconds before tombstones and state information are purged; default one week.
replication.createManager: Create the account (or set its password)
replication.managerHint: The account other suppliers bind as; its password must match the agreements pointing here.
replication.disableShort: Deletes the agreements; other servers stop receiving changes from here.
replication.disableWarning: Replication of {suffix} stops and its agreements are deleted. The data stays.
replication.deleteAgreementConfirm: Delete the agreement {name}? The consumer stops receiving changes from here.
replication.consumerNoAgreements: A consumer does not send changes, so it has no agreements.
replication.initConfirm: Replace all data of the suffix on {host} with the data of this server?
replication.scheduleHint: HHMM-HHMM and days (0 = Sunday … 6), e.g. 2200-0600 0123456; empty: always.
replication.excludedHint: Fractional replication: these attributes stay on this server.
replication.noChangelog: This replica has no changelog (consumers do not keep one).
replication.maxAgeHint: e.g. 7d; units s, m, h, d, w. Empty: no limit.
replication.ruvHint: The newest change this server has seen from each supplier. A supplier far behind the others is not receiving changes.
replication.cleanRUVConfirm: Remove replica ID {rid} from the RUVs of all servers? Do this only for a supplier that has been removed for good.
replication.conflictsHint: Entries two suppliers changed incompatibly (e.g. added with the same DN). Keep one under a new RDN or delete it.
replication.converted: Conflict entry kept under the new RDN.

tls.subject: Subject
tls.subjectHint: Distinguished name of the server, e.g. CN=ldap.example.org,O=Example.
tls.pendingRestart: another certificate is chosen; restart to apply
tls.noFiles: ds-ui cannot reach the server's NSS database in this mode (remote): certificates are managed on the server host.
tls.keysWarning: Backups of the server include the private keys of this database.
tls.nicknameHint: Name of the certificate in the NSS database.
tls.trustHint: NSS trust flags for TLS, e-mail, code, e.g. CT,, — a CA trusted for server and client certificates; ,, — not trusted.
tls.useAsServerConfirm: The server will present {name} after the next restart.
tls.afterRestart: Takes effect after a server restart.
tls.deleteWithKey: Delete the certificate {name} and its private key? This cannot be undone.

importHints.pair: A server certificate obtained elsewhere, with its key.
importHints.ca: Trusted for server and client certificates (CT,,).
importHints.csr: A key is generated in the database; send the request to your CA, then add the issued certificate.
importHints.issued: The certificate your CA issued for a request made here; it joins its key in the database.

tls.dnsNamesHint: Names clients use to reach the server.
tls.csrReady: The key is in the database. Send this request to your CA.

source.title: Certificate from files
source.description: The server certificate follows PEM files kept up to date by an external tool (certbot, lego, cert-manager). When the files hold a new certificate, ds-ui imports it, makes it the server certificate and records it in the task history; a certificate with the same subject replaces the previous one.
source.autoRestart: the server restarts after an import
source.manualRestart: restart the server to apply a new certificate
source.hint: To follow a certificate from certbot, lego or cert-manager automatically, point ds-ui at its files with DSUI_CERT_FILE and DSUI_CERT_KEY_FILE (see the deployment guide).

login.title: Sign in
login.readOnly: View only: your role cannot change these settings.
login.noAccess: The password is right, but this account has no access to ds-ui. Ask an administrator to add it to a ds-ui group.
login.tooMany: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes.

encryption.description: Values of these attributes are stored encrypted (AES) in the database files, backups and changelog; clients read them in clear text as usual.
encryption.keyWarning: The encryption key is protected by the key of the server certificate. Renew the certificate with the same key (certbot --reuse-key, cert-manager rotationPolicy: Never): with a certificate of another key the server does not start, so ds-ui refuses such a switch while attributes are encrypted.
encryption.added: {attr} is encrypted from now on. Existing values are encrypted after an export and import of the suffix.
encryption.existingHint: Values written before encryption was turned on stay unencrypted until the suffix is exported and imported again (Export / import tab).
encryption.hasValues: Entries have values of {attr}. Once the server stops encrypting it, values stored encrypted read back as unreadable data after the next restart. First export the suffix with the clear-text option, then remove the setting and import that export.

passthru.title: Remote servers
passthru.description: Binds of DNs under a subtree are checked by these LDAP servers instead of this one. The subtree should not be stored on this server. Changes apply when the plug-in starts (after a restart).
passthru.saved: Saved; applies after the plug-in starts again (restart).
passthru.subtreeHint: Bind DNs below it are passed through.
passthru.hostsHint: host or host:port; tried in order.

uniqueness.addHint: Another instance of the plug-in with its own attributes and subtrees. It is created disabled; enable it in the list.
uniqueness.name: Name
uniqueness.subtreesHint: Empty: all suffixes of the server.

accountReport.title: Account report
accountReport.description: State of every account under the subtree, as in the account card of the LDAP browser: locked, locked by a role, locked out after failed logins, password expired or to be changed.
accountReport.truncated: Only the first {n} accounts are shown; narrow the subtree or the filter.

health.description: Checks settings, certificates, disks, databases, replication and plug-ins for problems. Nothing is changed.

anonymous-access.title: Anonymous access is allowed
anonymous-access.detail: Anyone can read what the ACIs allow without binding.
anonymous-access.fix: Set anonymous access to "rootdse" if clients always bind.

unauthenticated-binds.title: Unauthenticated binds are allowed
unauthenticated-binds.detail: A bind with a DN and an empty password succeeds as anonymous; applications may take it for a successful login.

plain-binds.title: Passwords may be sent without encryption
plain-binds.detail: TLS is on, but simple binds over plain LDAP are still accepted.
plain-binds.fix: Require secure binds or set a minimum SSF.

password-scheme-weak.title: Weak password storage: {scheme}
password-scheme-weak.detail: User passwords are stored in clear text or with a fast unsalted hash.
password-scheme-weak.fix: Choose PBKDF2-SHA512; passwords are re-hashed when users change them.

password-scheme-fast.title: Fast password hash: {scheme}
password-scheme-fast.detail: Salted SHA is fast to brute-force if the database leaks.

rootpw-scheme-weak.title: Weak storage of the Directory Manager password: {scheme}

rootpw-scheme-fast.title: Fast hash for the Directory Manager password: {scheme}
rootpw-scheme-fast.fix: Prefer PBKDF2-SHA512, then set the password again.

local-password-scheme-weak.title: Weak password storage in a local policy: {scheme}

local-password-scheme-fast.title: Fast password hash in a local policy: {scheme}

tls-off.title: TLS is off
tls-off.detail: Passwords and data travel in clear text.
tls-off.fix: Add a server certificate and turn on TLS.

tls-old-versions.title: Old TLS versions are allowed (from {version})
tls-old-versions.fix: Set the minimum version to TLS1.2.

server-cert-expired.title: The server certificate has expired
server-cert-expired.fix: Replace it on the Security page.

server-cert-expiring.title: The server certificate expires in {days} days
server-cert-expiring.fix: Renew it in time; with attribute encryption keep the same key.

ca-cert-expired.title: A trusted CA certificate has expired
ca-cert-expired.fix: Remove it or import its successor.

ca-cert-expiring.title: A trusted CA certificate expires in {days} days

server-cert-self-signed.title: The server certificate is self-signed
server-cert-self-signed.detail: {name}: clients cannot verify it without trusting it explicitly.
server-cert-self-signed.fix: Use a certificate from your CA.

server-cert-missing.title: The server certificate is not in the database
server-cert-missing.detail: nsSSLPersonalitySSL names {name}; TLS will not start.

disk-full.title: Disk almost full: {partition} {percent}%
disk-full.detail: The server stops writing when the disk is full.
disk-full.fix: Free space or enlarge the volume.

disk-filling.title: Disk filling up: {partition} {percent}%
disk-filling.fix: Free space or enlarge the volume; rotate and delete old logs.

disk-monitoring-off.title: Disk monitoring is off
disk-monitoring-off.detail: Without it the server does not protect itself from a full disk.

suffix-no-root.title: Suffix without a root entry: {suffix}
suffix-no-root.detail: The backend exists but holds no entries.
suffix-no-root.fix: Create the root entry or import data.

backend-not-serving.title: Suffix not served from its database: {suffix}

entry-cache-small.title: Entry cache too small: {backend}
entry-cache-small.detail: The cache is full and serves only {ratio}% of lookups.
entry-cache-small.fix: Enlarge the entry cache of the suffix.

agreement-error.title: Replication fails: {agreement}
agreement-error.fix: Check the consumer, credentials and network; see the errors log.

changelog-unbounded.title: Replication changelog grows without limit
changelog-unbounded.detail: {suffix}: no maximum age or number of entries.

replication-conflicts.title: Replication conflicts: {count}
replication-conflicts.fix: Resolve them in the Replication section.

plugin-attr-not-indexed.title: {attribute} is not indexed in {backend}
plugin-attr-not-indexed.detail: The {plugin} plug-in searches by it on every change.
plugin-attr-not-indexed.fix: Add an equality index and reindex.

retro-changelog-unbounded.title: Retro changelog grows without limit
retro-changelog-unbounded.detail: The plug-in is on without a maximum age.

error-log-debug.title: Debug logging is on (level {level})
error-log-debug.detail: Extra error-log levels slow the server and fill the disk.
error-log-debug.fix: Set the level back to 16384 when done.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Follows the agreements of this server to the other servers, and theirs further on, and compares what each server has received from each supplier. The other servers are reached as the agreements name them.
topology.bindDN: Bind DN on the other servers
topology.insecure: Do not verify the certificates of the other servers
topology.notStored: The credentials are sent with this request only and are not stored.
topology.plain: Reached over plain LDAP — the password crossed the network unencrypted: {servers}
topology.truncated: Only the first 20 servers are shown.
topology.ownCredentials: These servers refused the credentials; enter their own and build again:
topology.noLinks: No agreements: this server sends changes nowhere.
